scripts.dev:api: wrangler dev -c services/core/wrangler.jsonc -c services/metadata/wrangler.jsonc -c services/notify/wrangler.jsonc -c services/convo/wrangler.jsonc --port 8787 --inspector-port 9229 --persist-to .wrangler/state --var COVERS_PUBLIC_URL:http://localhost:8787/v1/covers --var APP_URL:http://localhost:3000 --var DEV_AUTH:true
scripts.db:migrate: wrangler d1 migrations apply cdl-core --local --persist-to .wrangler/state -c services/core/wrangler.jsonc && wrangler d1 migrations apply cdl-metadata --local --persist-to .wrangler/state -c services/metadata/wrangler.jsonc && wrangler d1 migrations apply cdl-convo --local --persist-to .wrangler/state -c services/convo/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.db:seed: wrangler d1 execute cdl-core --local --persist-to .wrangler/state -c services/core/wrangler.jsonc --file services/core/scripts/seed.sql
scripts.db:seed:things: wrangler d1 execute cdl-core --local --persist-to .wrangler/state -c services/core/wrangler.jsonc --file services/core/scripts/seed-things.sql
scripts.library:books: wrangler d1 execute cdl-core --local --persist-to .wrangler/state -c services/core/wrangler.jsonc --command "UPDATE communities SET type = 'books'"
scripts.library:things: wrangler d1 execute cdl-core --local --persist-to .wrangler/state -c services/core/wrangler.jsonc --command "UPDATE communities SET type = 'things'"
